description: This file implements a DialogManager class for handling modal dialogs in a React application, including opening, closing, and registering dialogs with optional pre-open hooks.

classes.name: _DialogManager
classes.description: Class managing dialog instances, opening, closing, and registration of dialogs.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a dialog component with specified props, returns a promise resolving to the result or false if already open.

methods.name: closeAll
methods.description: Closes all open dialogs and removes modal elements from DOM.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a dialog component with optional pre-open hook, providing show and close methods.
